q: Do I need an account to donate?
a: No. Anyone can donate without registering. If you create an account, you'll be able to download receipts later, see your donation history, and set up recurring donations.

q: Can I set up recurring donations?
a: Yes. After making a first donation while logged in, you can convert it to a monthly recurring donation. You can pause or cancel at any time from your dashboard.

q: Can I edit a campaign after it's published?
a: You can edit the description, photos and updates at any time. The goal amount, category and identity are locked after approval — to change them, contact support and we'll review.

q: What if my campaign is rejected?
a: You'll get a message explaining why, and you can resubmit after fixing the issue. Common reasons: missing documents, unclear story, unrealistic goal amount.
Any time after your first completed donation. There's no minimum balance and no waiting period.

q: How long does a withdrawal take?
a: 1–3 business days. Each withdrawal is reviewed manually against your verified identity before payout.
Platform fee and payment processing fees are deducted automatically. The exact split is shown on every withdrawal request before you confirm.

q: Why must the bank card name match my verified name?
a: It's a fraud protection rule — funds raised by a verified person can only be paid to a card in that same person's name. This stops compromised accounts from redirecting donations.

q: Can I withdraw to a relative's card?
a: No. The card must be in the same legal name as your verified identity.
Click Sign Up. You can register with your phone number (we'll send an SMS code) or with your Telegram account in one tap.

q: What if I don't get the SMS code?
a: Try the Telegram login option instead — it's instant. If you still need SMS, double-check your number and try again in a minute.

q: How do I link Telegram to an existing account?
a: Go to Profile → Linked Accounts → Link Telegram. The Telegram Login Widget will open and link your account in one tap.

q: How do I change my email?
a: Profile → Linked Accounts → Edit email. You'll be sent a 6-digit code to verify the new address before it's saved.

q: What's the difference between Telegram login and Telegram notifications?
a: Login uses Telegram to verify who you are — like signing in. Notifications are messages we send to your Telegram chat about donations, campaign updates and so on. They're separate features and you can have one without the other.

q: How do I enable Telegram notifications?
a: Open @SahovatTechBot on Telegram and tap Start. After that, choose which events you want notifications for in Profile → Notifications.

q: Can I turn off SMS notifications?
a: Yes — Profile → Notifications shows a grid of events (donation receipts, withdrawal updates, etc.) crossed with channels (SMS, Telegram, Email). Toggle each independently.

q: I'm not getting SMS or Telegram messages — what now?
a: Check Profile → Notifications to confirm the channel is enabled for that event. If it is, contact support — most cases are resolved by re-linking your phone or Telegram account.

q: Will you send me marketing messages?
a: No. We only send transactional notifications about your donations, campaigns or account. There's no marketing channel.
